preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and len(stdin) > 0 and all(c in '()' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: stdin is a non-empty string composed exclusively of '(' and ')' characters.
The length of stdin does not exceed 1,000,000 characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0 1' or (stdout.count(' ') == 1 and stdout.split() == [str(max_len), str(count)] and max_len >= 0 and count >= 0)
postconditions.description: stdout is either '0 1' (if no regular bracket substring exists) or a space-separated pair of integers: the length of the longest regular bracket substring (max_len) and the number of such substrings (count).

postconditions.expression: all(len(sub) == max_len and is_regular(sub) for sub in substrings) and len(substrings) == count
postconditions.description: For the parsed max_len and count from stdout, there exists a set of substrings of stdin where each substring has length max_len, is a regular bracket sequence, and there are exactly count such substrings. If max_len is 0, no regular bracket substring exists.

postconditions.expression: max_len == 0 or any(len(sub) == max_len and is_regular(sub) for sub in substrings)
postconditions.description: If max_len is greater than 0, there exists at least one substring of stdin with length max_len that is a regular bracket sequence.
